name: _a11y.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  _a11y.scss — accessibility utility rules for the DOCUMENT stylesheet AND
//  every component shadow root.
//
//  `.sr-only` — the visually-hidden pattern for helper-injected nodes (the
//  animation-description `<span>`s stamped by core/utils/a11y/animation-desc).
//  The class token lives in core/tokens/classes/a11y.ts (A11Y_CLASSES.SR_ONLY)
//  and this rule is its sole declaration site — the spellings match by
//  construction, same convention as the skeleton selectors.
//
//  Two delivery paths consume this one authored file:
//    1. Document: `@import 'structure/a11y'` inside _structure.scss — the
//       global <link> sheet, hiding light-DOM description nodes.
//    2. Shadow: `?inline`-imported into BASE_HOST_STYLES
//       (core/tokens/styles.ts) — BaseComponent prepends that text to every
//       component's adopted stylesheet (and to the legacy <style>-node
//       fallback), so shadow-injected description nodes are hidden too.
//
//  `display:none` is deliberately NOT used — it would evict the node from
//  the accessibility tree; the clipped-1px recipe keeps the text present
//  for assistive tech, crawlers, AI agents and reader mode while painting
//  nothing on-screen.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}
